title: Launch Coordination Matrix: SDK & API — Function Calling, Structured Output, Streaming
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a cross-functional launch coordination matrix for the SDK and API surface changes: function calling, structured output, and streaming. Deliverables: release notes, docs and migration guides, working samples across official SDKs, release checklist for hosted/dedicated/private, and GTM enablement artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Final release notes approved by PM & Legal
Docs updated with examples for function calling + structured output + streaming
Three platform SDK samples (Python, JS, Go) published and running in CI
Rollout plan documented with canary thresholds and rollback steps
Support and Sales enablement assets ready at time of public announcement
tasks: Draft release notes and get legal/marketing sign-off
Coordinate with Eng to freeze API surface and document breaking changes
Prioritize sample set: streaming chat, structured-data generation, function-calling orchestration
Create migration notes and quickstart for existing customers
Prepare console release checklist for rollout to Dedicated and Private customers
release_notes_draft:
Highlights: GA support for structured output schemas, streaming responses with partial JSON frames, and function calling primitives across official SDKs. Breaking changes: small header rename in the streaming protocol; see migration notes. Impact: customers can adopt structured output to integrate with downstream parsers and orchestrators; streaming reduces time-to-first-token for interactive apps. Known limitations: private deployments need runtime-1.18+ to enable streaming 
Migration steps: update SDK to latest client, migrate streaming session code per examples, run provided validation test cases.
docs_tasks: Update API reference for function calling and structured-output params
Author 'Streaming best practices' guide with batching/latency tradeoffs
Write migration guide for existing streaming users (header mapping)
Add structured-output validation examples and schema snippets
Page-level TOC and redirects for previous streaming doc versions
samples_tasks: Python: streaming chat + function-calling orchestrator (CI passing)
JS/Node: browser-friendly streaming example with SSE + structured JSON
Go: low-latency server example demonstrating KV cache usage
End-to-end sample that shows fallback from dedicated -> hosted when capacity constrained
Add tests and linting to samples repo and wire to SDK CI
rollout_plan: Staged rollout over 4 weeks: Week 0 - internal dogfood and SDK pre-release to beta customers; Week 1 - hosted GA with feature flags enabled for 20% traffic; Week 2 - lift GA to 100% hosted traffic, open SDKs; Week 3 - coordinated rollout for Dedicated (customer opt-in) and Private (shipped in on-prem bundle). Canary thresholds: error rate <0.5% and P95 latency within 10% of baseline. If thresholds are breached, rollback to previous runtime variant and notify stakeholders via #launch-alerts.
communication_plan: Internal kickoff email & Loom demo to Eng/SDK/Docs/Support/Success
Public announcement blog post + changelog entry on release day
Customer-facing release notes with migration checklist
Sales enablement deck and playbook (1-pager) distributed to AE team
Support playbook: common tickets and troubleshooting steps
risks: Runtime incompatibilities on older Dedicated clusters (mitigation: runtime gating and clear pre-upgrade checklist)
Docs and samples not synced with final SDK API (mitigation: lock API by 2026-03-24 and freeze PRs)
Unclear migration path for heavy streaming customers (mitigation: offer migration office hours)
Release notes ambiguous language could trigger support churn (mitigation: Legal and Support review)
